description: Read the knowledge graph, or a page of it: the optional limit and offset take a slice of the entities in name order. Use it for the whole graph; for a query use search_nodes, for names you already know use open_nodes, and for the elements more than one node wrote use read_conflicts. A page carries the relations that touch its entities. To read only what changed since your last visit, use read_changes.

limit.description: The most entities to return; omit for all of them

offset.description: How many entities to skip before the page; omit for none

name: read_graph

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

title: Read Graph
